svg.aria-label: Scatter of 339 Bolivian municipalities, 2017. Nighttime lights are population-weighted mean VIIRS radiance in nW/sr/cm² on a logarithmic axis. The vertical axis is the SDG 1 No Poverty achievement index from 0 to 100; higher means less poverty. No fitted line is shown.
